scenarios.name: ordinary-chat-native
scenarios.negativeCase: ordinary chat must not create a Task Ledger root or enter /loop state
scenarios.realValue: ordinary chat should not pay harness-switch complexity
scenarios.negativeEvidence: task root created or harness forced

scenarios.name: normal-codex-turn
scenarios.negativeCase: missing app-server binary must not silently fall back after side effects
scenarios.realValue: repository work gets a Codex-native thread and tool loop
scenarios.negativeEvidence: missing binary falls through to native after side effects

scenarios.name: explicit-codex-control
scenarios.negativeCase: missing bound thread shows an explicit error and never invents a thread
scenarios.realValue: resume/steer/stop an existing Codex thread explicitly
scenarios.negativeEvidence: invents a thread or silently uses ACP

scenarios.name: packaged-desktop-launch
scenarios.negativeCase: dev-only pnpm link is not packaged availability
scenarios.realValue: installed app can actually launch managed Codex
scenarios.negativeEvidence: dev link works but packaged tree is missing binary

scenarios.name: ci-headless
scenarios.negativeCase: coding-run projection is not a Codex CLI compatibility layer
scenarios.realValue: bounded CI/headless execution without pretending to be Codex CLI

scenarios.name: acp-alternative
scenarios.negativeCase: absent adapter fails closed; no hidden switch to Codex native
scenarios.realValue: explicitly use an available ACP adapter

scenarios.name: alternate-harness-evaluation
scenarios.negativeCase: a third-party demo is not proof of equivalent permissions/cost/quality
scenarios.realValue: measure a competitor only on a real scenario
scenarios.negativeEvidence: registry listing or demo becomes adoption proof

scenarios.name: versebrowser-task
scenarios.negativeCase: harness cannot bypass private-network denial or approval
scenarios.realValue: automate a real browser task under existing safety

scenarios.name: verseshell-execution
scenarios.negativeCase: external-write is not a journal-backed rollback
scenarios.realValue: run a real bounded command with receipt

scenarios.name: versegit-concurrent-candidate
scenarios.negativeCase: VG advisory/admitted is not harness verdict or task completion
scenarios.realValue: give agent repository facts while isolating candidates

scenarios.name: failure-fallback
scenarios.negativeCase: missing binary/auth/timeout must expose failure rather than a successful-looking result
scenarios.realValue: fail honestly when runtime/auth/adapter is unavailable
